title: TubeAutonomy Exact Job Resolution Verified
description: Verification render after fixing exact push-SHA checkout and selected upstream integrations.
script: This is the third integration verification for TubeAutonomy. The render runner now checks out the exact GitHub push commit before resolving the job file, so a moving branch can no longer silently replace a requested video with the demo. The upstream tool manifest is verified in continuous integration, and the autonomous writer can use a local Qwen model when no Gemini key is available. Trend discovery can also fall back to public YouTube metadata through yt-dlp. Rendering still uses Kokoro narration, MoneyPrinterTurbo, FFmpeg, and faster-whisper quality assurance before any automatic publishing decision.
